timing: Absolute source-video seconds. Each form is fully covered with adjacent exclusive-end intervals.
provenance: Manual visual teaching-phase review of the supplied recording at 0.5-second intervals, with source-picture contact sheets. Cues describe visible movement only; Pose does not verify palm/finger orientation.
teachingNotes: Small visible phases, including synchronized arm/leg movement, are preserved. Settle phases provide a separate pause target. Use a comfortable kick height and stance depth; exact instructor range is not required. The last target is before the source fade.

steps.title: Gather the stepping knee
steps.cue: Bring the stepping foot in as both hands begin to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 随着双手开始上提，把准备迈出的脚收拢。

steps.title: Place the forward heel
steps.cue: Reach the foot forward while both arms continue their upward arc.
steps.chineseCue: 脚向前伸出，同时双臂继续向上画弧。

steps.title: Settle and lower the arms
steps.cue: Settle into the step as the hands sweep down in front.
steps.chineseCue: 落稳这一步，双手随身体在身前向下落。

steps.title: Raise the right knee
steps.cue: Draw the right foot up into a bent-knee balance.
steps.chineseCue: 把右脚收起，屈膝上提。

steps.title: Bring the forearms up
steps.cue: Keep the knee gathered while the forearms rise in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖保持收拢，双前臂向胸前提起。

steps.title: Extend the right heel
steps.cue: Extend the right heel while opening the arms; use a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 右脚跟向外伸出，双臂同时展开；高度以舒服为准。

steps.title: Settle the open shape
steps.cue: Follow the open arm shape with the leg extended at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂保持展开，伸出的腿停在自己舒服的高度。

steps.title: Fold the right knee back
steps.cue: Bend the raised knee again as the arms move forward.
steps.chineseCue: 抬着的腿再次屈膝收回，双臂同时转向前方。

steps.title: Gather both hands
steps.cue: Keep the knee raised while drawing both hands slightly inward.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖仍抬着，双手稍稍向内收拢。

steps.title: Lower the right heel
steps.cue: Lower the raised leg forward while the hands descend.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的腿向前放下，双手同时下落。

steps.title: Plant the foot and open
steps.cue: Plant the stepping foot and open both arms as the body settles forward.
steps.chineseCue: 迈出的脚落稳，身体向前落，双臂同时展开。

steps.title: Arc both forearms forward
steps.cue: Bring both bent arms upward and inward together.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂同时屈肘，向上、向前合拢。

steps.title: Settle the paired-arm shape
steps.cue: Let the forward stance and paired arms finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 前方站姿和双臂一起停稳。

steps.title: Begin the turn
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso away as the arms arc upward.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向另一面，双臂同时向上画弧。

steps.title: Finish turning and lower
steps.cue: Continue the turn while lowering the hands toward the waist.
steps.chineseCue: 继续转身，双手同时落向腰部附近。

steps.title: Raise the left knee
steps.cue: Gather the left leg into a bent-knee balance.
steps.chineseCue: 收拢左腿，屈膝上提。

steps.title: Raise the forearms
steps.cue: Keep the knee gathered as both forearms rise in front.
steps.chineseCue: 膝盖保持收拢，双前臂在身前上提。

steps.title: Extend the left heel
steps.cue: Open the arms as the left heel extends; use a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 左脚跟向外伸出，双臂同时展开；高度以舒服为准。

steps.title: Settle the left-leg extension
steps.cue: Follow the open shape without needing the instructor's kick height.
steps.chineseCue: 停稳展开姿态，不必追求示范中的踢腿高度。

steps.title: Fold the left knee back
steps.cue: Bend the raised left leg while keeping the arms open.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的左腿屈膝收回，双臂仍展开。

forms.title: Left Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Gather the arms
steps.cue: Bring the arms toward one side while keeping the knee gathered.
steps.chineseCue: 抬膝保持收拢，双臂向一侧转过来。

steps.title: Reach the left foot sideways
steps.cue: Lower and reach the left foot out to the side.
steps.chineseCue: 左脚向侧方放下、伸开。

steps.title: Lower into the wide stance
steps.cue: Bend the supporting leg as one hand sweeps downward; choose your own depth.
steps.chineseCue: 支撑腿弯曲，一只手同时向下扫；下沉深度以自己能做为准。

steps.title: Move across the wide stance
steps.cue: Move the torso toward the extended-leg side as the low arm travels forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向伸腿的一侧移动，低处的手臂同时向前走。

steps.title: Rise into the forward stance
steps.cue: Rise gradually as the leading arm reaches forward.
steps.chineseCue: 身体逐渐升起，前方手臂随之向前伸。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Draw the rear foot inward while both hands sweep down.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双手同时向下画弧。

steps.title: Raise the right knee and arm
steps.cue: Lift the right knee while one forearm rises in front.
steps.chineseCue: 右膝上提，同时一侧前臂在身前升起。

steps.title: Settle the one-leg shape
steps.cue: Pause in the gathered-knee shape at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 在自己舒服的抬膝高度停稳。

forms.title: Right Snake Creeps Down and Golden Rooster

steps.title: Lower the raised foot
steps.cue: Lower the raised foot as the torso turns toward the camera.
steps.chineseCue: 放下抬起的脚，身体同时向正面转。

steps.title: Turn under the raised arm
steps.cue: Continue turning while the upper arm follows an overhead arc.
steps.chineseCue: 上方手臂画弧，身体继续转向。

steps.title: Reach the right foot sideways
steps.cue: Send the right foot sideways as the arms gather to the new side.
steps.chineseCue: 右脚向侧方伸出，双臂同时向新的一侧收拢。

steps.title: Lower into the other wide stance
steps.cue: Bend the supporting leg and let the lower hand descend; use your own depth.
steps.chineseCue: 支撑腿弯曲，低处的手臂下降；下沉深度以自己能做为准。

steps.title: Sweep the low arm across
steps.cue: Follow the low arm across the extended leg as the torso turns.
steps.chineseCue: 随着身体转动，低处手臂沿伸腿方向横扫。

steps.title: Move across and begin rising
steps.cue: Move toward the extended-leg side and begin to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向伸腿一侧横移，并开始升起。

steps.title: Reach into the forward stance
steps.cue: Continue rising while the leading arm extends ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 继续起身，前方手臂同时伸出。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward as both hands lower.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双手同时下落。

steps.title: Raise the left knee and arm
steps.cue: Lift the left knee while one forearm rises in front.
steps.chineseCue: 左膝上提，一侧前臂同时在身前升起。

steps.title: Settle the second one-leg shape
steps.cue: Pause with the knee gathered at a comfortable height.
steps.chineseCue: 抬膝保持收拢，在舒服的高度停稳。

steps.title: Place the raised foot forward
steps.cue: Lower the raised foot into the next step as the hands separate.
steps.chineseCue: 抬起的脚向前落下，双手同时分开。

steps.title: Settle and gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Settle into the step and draw the rear foot inward.
steps.chineseCue: 先随着这一步落稳，后脚继续向身体收拢。

steps.title: Turn and gather the arms
steps.cue: Turn toward the first diagonal while the hands circle inward.
steps.chineseCue: 转向第一个斜前方，双手同时向内画弧。

steps.title: Step onto the first diagonal
steps.cue: Place the next foot diagonally as the upper arm begins to lift.
steps.chineseCue: 向第一个斜前方落脚，上方手臂同时开始抬起。

steps.title: Lift one arm and reach
steps.cue: Settle forward as one arm curves overhead and the other reaches ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向前落，一臂向头上画弧，另一臂同时向前伸。

steps.title: Settle the first diagonal shape
steps.cue: Let the overhead arm and forward arm finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 上方手臂和前方手臂一起停稳。

steps.title: Turn toward the other side
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso as both arms circle back in front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向，双臂同时画弧回到身前。

steps.title: Gather the next stepping foot
steps.cue: Draw the next stepping foot inward while the hands lower and gather.
steps.chineseCue: 准备迈出的脚向身体收拢，双手同时下落、收拢。

steps.title: Step onto the second diagonal
steps.cue: Reach the heel out toward the next diagonal while the arms begin to open.
steps.chineseCue: 脚跟向另一个斜前方伸出，双臂同时开始展开。

steps.title: Lift the other overhead arm
steps.cue: Settle into the new step while the other arm arcs above the head.
steps.chineseCue: 身体落入新的一步，另一侧手臂同时向头上画弧。

steps.title: Finish the forward reach
steps.cue: Extend the forward arm and settle the second diagonal stance.
steps.chineseCue: 前方手臂伸出，第二个斜向站姿一起落稳。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward as the arms begin to lower.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双臂同时开始下落。

steps.title: Shift back and turn
steps.cue: Move back over the rear leg while turning the torso and gathering the arms.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向后腿一侧移动，躯干转动，双臂收拢。

steps.title: Gather the front knee
steps.cue: Draw the front foot up while one hand comes near the shoulder.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚收起，一只手同时收至肩部附近。

steps.title: Place the foot and reach down
steps.cue: Place the foot lightly forward as the torso inclines and the hand descends.
steps.chineseCue: 脚向前轻轻放下，身体同时前倾，手向下伸。

steps.title: Settle the low reach
steps.cue: Finish the downward reach at a comfortable depth.
steps.chineseCue: 在自己舒服的深度完成向下伸展。

steps.title: Rise and lift the arms
steps.cue: Begin rising from the low reach as both arms lift in front.
steps.chineseCue: 从低处开始起身，双臂同时在身前提起。

steps.title: Step forward and separate
steps.cue: Reach the front heel forward while one arm rises and the other opens ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 前脚跟向前伸出，一臂向上、另一臂向前同时展开。

steps.title: Settle the high-and-forward shape
steps.cue: Settle into the step with one arm above and the other reaching forward.
steps.chineseCue: 随着脚步落稳，一臂在上，另一臂向前。

steps.title: Turn to the opposite direction
steps.cue: Pivot the feet and torso as the arms open and lower.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体一起转向，双臂同时展开并下落。

steps.title: Gather the stepping knee
steps.cue: Bring the next stepping foot up while one forearm circles across the body.
steps.chineseCue: 准备迈出的脚收起，一侧前臂同时绕过身前。

steps.title: Reach the heel forward
steps.cue: Reach the heel forward while the bent forearm turns upward.
steps.chineseCue: 脚跟向前伸出，屈着的前臂同时向上转。

steps.title: Plant the foot and sweep ahead
steps.cue: Set the foot down and move forward as the forearm travels ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 脚落下，身体随之前移，前臂同时向前走。

steps.title: Gather the rear foot and open
steps.cue: Bring the rear foot inward while both arms open apart.
steps.chineseCue: 后脚向身体收拢，双臂同时向两侧展开。

steps.title: Raise the next knee
steps.cue: Bring the next knee up as the arms continue to exchange positions.
steps.chineseCue: 下一侧膝盖上提，双臂同时继续交换前后位置。

steps.title: Reach the next heel forward
steps.cue: Extend the gathered foot forward while the front hand reaches ahead.
steps.chineseCue: 收起的脚向前伸出，前方手臂同时向前走。

steps.title: Settle behind the forward hand
steps.cue: Plant the foot and settle forward with the open hand in front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚落稳，身体向前落，前方手臂伸出。

steps.title: Extend the punching arm
steps.cue: Bring the other forearm forward as the body moves into the stance.
steps.chineseCue: 另一侧前臂向前伸出，身体同时进入前方站姿。

steps.title: Settle the forward extension
steps.cue: Let the extended arm and stance finish together.
steps.chineseCue: 伸出的手臂与站姿一起停稳。

steps.title: Bring the hands together ahead
steps.cue: Bring the lower hand toward the extended forearm in front.
steps.chineseCue: 下方的手向前方伸出的前臂靠拢。

steps.title: Shift back and bend the elbows
steps.cue: Move the torso back while both elbows bend.
steps.chineseCue: 身体向后移动，双肘同时弯曲。

steps.title: Lower the gathered hands
steps.cue: Continue drawing the hands down toward the waist.
steps.chineseCue: 双手继续向下收至腰部附近。

steps.title: Move forward and raise the hands
steps.cue: Move forward again as both hands rise in front of the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 身体再次向前移动，双手同时提至胸前。

steps.title: Extend both arms forward
steps.cue: Extend both arms and settle into the forward stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂向前伸出，前方站姿同时落稳。

steps.title: Turn toward the camera
steps.cue: Turn the feet and torso toward the camera as one arm arcs across the front.
steps.chineseCue: 脚和身体转向正面，一臂同时在身前画弧。

steps.title: Open both arms wide
steps.cue: Open the arms to either side while settling into the wide stance.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂向两侧展开，身体同时落入较宽的站姿。

steps.title: Lower both arms
steps.cue: Let both arms sweep outward and down together.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂一起向外、向下画弧。

steps.title: Cross the forearms low
steps.cue: Bring the forearms inward and across as the torso begins to rise.
steps.chineseCue: 双前臂向内交叉，身体同时开始升起。

steps.title: Gather the foot and lift the cross
steps.cue: Bring the wide foot inward while the crossed forearms rise toward the chest.
steps.chineseCue: 外侧脚向内收，交叉的双前臂同时提向胸前。

steps.title: Settle the crossed-arm stance
steps.cue: Settle both feet and hold the crossed forearms in front.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚落稳，交叉的双前臂停在身前。

steps.title: Uncross the forearms
steps.cue: Uncross both forearms and separate the hands in front.
steps.chineseCue: 把交叉的双前臂解开，双手在身前分开。

steps.title: Reach both hands forward
steps.cue: Let both hands reach gently forward together.
steps.chineseCue: 双手一起轻轻向前展开。

steps.title: Lower the hands and rise
steps.cue: Lower both hands while the knees straighten gradually.
steps.chineseCue: 双手下落，双膝同时逐渐伸展。

steps.title: Settle the arms at the sides
steps.cue: Let both arms finish lowering beside the body.
steps.chineseCue: 双臂继续落下，停在身体两侧。

steps.title: Bring the left foot in
steps.cue: Bring the left foot inward to close the stance.
steps.chineseCue: 把左脚向内收拢，站姿合起。

steps.title: Finish standing
steps.cue: Stand with the feet gathered and the arms resting at the sides.
steps.chineseCue: 双脚并拢，双臂自然落在身侧，停稳。
